access_declined: Several sign-in requests for the example account were declined.
session_opened: A new sign-in session was accepted for the same example account.
owner_disputes: The account owner reported that they did not recognise this sign-in session.
owner_confirms: The account owner confirmed that they recognised this sign-in session.
endpoint_block: Protection on the example workstation blocked an application process.
process_observed: A separate inventory check observed the same application process running on the workstation.
endpoint_note: The workstation policy recorded a second blocked application event.
backup_late: The example service's scheduled backup missed its usual recovery window.
restore_pending: The restore verification has no result for the delayed backup.
restore_verified: An independent restore exercise verified a usable copy for this recovery window.
monitor_gap: The alert collector reported a gap in telemetry for the example service.
feed_resumed: The monitoring feed resumed reporting after the gap.
